part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts:205-213 — when an input source map lacked `sourcesContent`, `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]` threw because `sourcesContent` is `null`/`undefined` in that case.

The fix uses optional chaining (`sourcesContent?.[i]`) so `setSourceContent` receives `undefined` and simply skips that source, instead of crashing.

Verified:
- Reproduction from the issue (input map without `sourcesContent`) now generates a valid source map.
- All tests pass: `packages/babel-generator` (591 passed), `packages/babel-core` + `packages/babel-standalone` (484 passed).
